turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical promo for Northside Gym. Use a welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding, with upbeat music and no voiceover. Keep these details on screen together for the last 5 seconds: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Big enough to read on a phone.
